source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 暗劲回拉，逆掌翻局
title: 暗劲回拉，逆掌翻局
purpose: 承接 SC21：拓拔野已被十四郎压制，白龙鹿刚扑上来护主。此段要把暗助反转拆清楚：先是暗劲回拉救险，再是拓拔野借势反击，接着众人震惊，最后落到科沙度的冷静起疑。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、招式名文字或任何可读文本。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 and SH02 anchor to the approved SC21 gate-space confrontation. SH03 inherits the same spatial continuity for the public reversal. SH04 shifts emphasis to Keshadu's deduction while staying in the same moonlit gate court.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, taunts, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 忽然一股强大的力气将自己朝后一拉。
定有人在背后以魔法或高强内力遥控拓拔野。

The white-clothed woman remains outwardly still and controlled, with only subtle implication that she is the hidden source of aid. The white dragon-deer stays in the same gate-space as protective presence, not a separate fantasy spectacle. Keep the moonlit gate, wet stone, bamboo, and courtyard threshold continuous. shots.title: 借势反掌击退
shots.location: 禁院门前 / 反打落下
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the SC21 whip-hit storyboard as the spatial and emotional anchor. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, 16:9 involuntary-counter composition. Adult Tuobaye is still battered and off-balance, but in the same breath of the hidden pull he lashes out with a rough sudden counterattack that slams into Fourteen and knocks him backward or downward. The strike should read as surprising and slightly involuntary, not as a polished martial-arts hero pose. Fourteen must look stunned that Tuobaye could connect at all.
